admission.justification: Cycle identification and component scheduling in master_order.py and cycle propagation in _task_order.py prevent legacy cycles from looking like independent ready work or being split apart when one member is already in work.

applicability: Dependency cycles already present in legacy master task data, including cycle members already in work.
conditions: The cycle’s task IDs are identified and its members remain together in one marked wave.
exclusions: Using the marked wave as task-start permission.
statement: Dependency cycles already held in legacy data are identified and kept together in one marked wave, including members already in work.
